insights.summary: The agent performed a high-quality direct edit that addressed the core logic of the prefix caching system. It demonstrated strong understanding of the codebase by identifying specific overheads like object creation and inefficient prefix matching.
strengths: Very fast identification of the bottleneck.
Implemented multiple distinct optimization patterns (caching, fast-paths, algorithmic changes).
weaknesses: Potential performance regression by moving hashing from C (built-in) to Python (FNV-1a).
